stories.h: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
stories.s: OpenAI’s latest funding round doesn't seem to be living up to expectations.

techmeme.com: Sources: OpenAI has secured ~$11B in commitments for its latest funding round, less than half its initial $30B target, and expects to raise more in coming weeks (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)
